CLARET ASSET MANAGEMENT Corp trimmed its stake in shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 10.4% during the 1st quarter, HoldingsChannel.com reports. The fund owned 57,692 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 6,702 shares during the quarter. Apple makes up about 2.2% of CLARET ASSET MANAGEMENT Corp’s investment portfolio, making the stock its 12th largest position. CLARET ASSET MANAGEMENT Corp’s holdings in Apple were worth $9,680,000 as of its most recent filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission.
A number of other institutional investors also recently bought and sold shares of AAPL. Guidant Wealth Advisors grew its holdings in Apple by 19.9% during the fourth quarter. Guidant Wealth Advisors now owns 4,829 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $841,000 after acquiring an additional 800 shares during the period. McCollum Christoferson Group LLC acquired a new stake in Apple in the fourth quarter valued at approximately $6,792,000. Contravisory Investment Management Inc. grew its holdings in Apple by 10.9% in the fourth quarter. Contravisory Investment Management Inc. now owns 3,973 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $672,000 after purchasing an additional 391 shares during the period. State of Alaska Department of Revenue grew its holdings in Apple by 9,271.4% in the fourth quarter. State of Alaska Department of Revenue now owns 500,432 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $84,686,000 after purchasing an additional 495,092 shares during the period. Finally, Baker Boyer National Bank grew its holdings in Apple by 1.5% in the fourth quarter. Baker Boyer National Bank now owns 31,591 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $5,346,000 after purchasing an additional 453 shares during the period. 58.33% of the stock is currently owned by hedge funds and other institutional investors. In related news, Director Arthur D. Levinson sold 20,000 shares of Apple stock in a transaction that occurred on Thursday, August 2nd. The stock was sold at an average price of $206.58, for a total transaction of $4,131,600.00. Following the transaction, the director now owns 1,153,283 shares in the company, valued at $238,245,202.14. The sale was disclosed in a document filed with the SEC, which is accessible through this link . Also, COO Jeffrey E. Williams sold 15,653 shares of Apple stock in a transaction that occurred on Friday, June 8th. The stock was sold at an average price of $190.94, for a total value of $2,988,783.82. Following the transaction, the chief operating officer now owns 147,819 shares in the company, valued at approximately $28,224,559.86. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . In the last quarter, insiders have sold 99,857 shares of company stock worth $19,222,507. 0.06% of the stock is currently owned by company insiders. Several brokerages have commented on AAPL. BidaskClub raised Apple from a “hold” rating to a “buy” rating in a report on Tuesday. Citigroup raised their price objective on Apple from $200.00 to $230.00 and gave the company a “buy” rating in a report on Thursday, August 2nd. Guggenheim reissued a “buy” rating and issued a $235.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a report on Wednesday, August 1st. BTIG Research raised Apple to a “buy” rating and raised their price objective for the company from $207.00 to $235.00 in a report on Wednesday, August 1st. Finally, Goldman Sachs Group reissued a “neutral” rating and issued a $200.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a report on Wednesday, August 1st. One investment analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, fifteen have given a hold rating, thirty-two have assigned a buy rating and one has assigned a strong buy rating to the company’s stock. Apple presently has a consensus rating of “Buy” and a consensus target price of $218.46.
Shares of NASDAQ:AAPL opened at $207.11 on Wednesday. The company has a current ratio of 1.31, a quick ratio of 1.24 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.84. The company has a market capitalization of $1,022.30 billion, a PE ratio of 22.50, a PEG ratio of 1.64 and a beta of 1.16. Apple Inc. has a 1 year low of $149.16 and a 1 year high of $209.50.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last announced its quarterly earnings data on Tuesday, July 31st. The iPhone maker reported $2.34 EPS for the quarter, topping the Zacks’ consensus estimate of $2.18 by $0.16. Apple had a return on equity of 43.50% and a net margin of 21.98%. The firm had revenue of $53.27 billion for the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $52.43 billion. During the same quarter last year, the business posted $1.67 earnings per share. The firm’s revenue was up 17.3% compared to the same quarter last year. research analysts anticipate that Apple Inc. will post 11.68 EPS for the current fiscal year.
Apple declared that its Board of Directors has approved a share buyback program on Tuesday, May 1st that authorizes the company to buyback $100.00 billion in outstanding shares. This buyback authorization authorizes the iPhone maker to reacquire up to 11.9% of its stock through open market purchases. Stock buyback programs are typically an indication that the company’s board believes its stock is undervalued.
The business also recently disclosed a quarterly dividend, which will be paid on Thursday, August 16th. Investors of record on Monday, August 13th will be given a dividend of $0.73 per share. The ex-dividend date of this dividend is Friday, August 10th. This represents a $2.92 dividend on an annualized basis and a yield of 1.41%. Apple’s payout ratio is 31.70%.
About Apple
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers to consumers, and small and mid-sized businesses; and education, enterprise, and government customers worldwide. The company also sells related software, services, accessories, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications.
